items.hypothesis: Bottleneck: the Agent's handling of authoritative-evaluate FAILs. In epoch 1 (agent-v0; all 6 sessions audited from their conversation.jsonl traces and attempt reports, both trajectories), every non-reproducible no-numbers evaluate FAIL (shape absent from BOTH the latency and error tables while the remaining aggregates are digit-identical to a recorded PASS) was initially mis-modeled, and three mutually inconsistent wrong causal models were independently derived and deposited: member-specific crash suspects (t2a1: ~55 min / 164-case forensic campaign, ~25% of the session; deposited 'permanent for the artifact / one member at a time'), 'digest-locked, never gamble, ship the incumbent' (t2a2: attempt fully blocked and abandoned with >7 h of budget left), and 'fixed contract inputs' plus hardening of an already-exonerated smem mechanism (t1a3: 235-case launch-blocking sweep, ~18% of calls, one full evaluate consumed by the flake). The decisive contract fact — 'Every selected Shape is checked on each evaluation, but each one draws fresh random inputs' (prompts/attempt-tools.md) — was present in the context of ALL SIX sessions (verified by grep over the transcripts) yet was applied by none at the FAIL decision point; t2a3 re-derived the correct per-draw environmental model only after ~15–25 turns falsifying its inherited wrong deposits, then won the epoch with the fresh-bytes gamble (PASS 90/90, 0.904x incumbent). Causal hypothesis: the failure is not information access but State architecture — (a) no canonical, task-agnostic decision procedure exists at the FAIL decision point (the correct rule lived only in an attempt-narrative memory file and a task-specific knowledge CAVEAT), and (b) superseded wrong models survived inside inherited State: knowledge/README.md still carried attempt-2's 'ship the byte-identical incumbent, don't gamble further evaluates' CAVEAT verbatim, contradicting the RESOLVED text of the very file it indexed, and memory/attempt2's own headline still asserted 'digest-locked ... blocks shipping any fresh candidate'. Each new session therefore re-derives or re-ingests a wrong model under FAIL pressure, burning wall time, tokens, gateway evaluates, and one entire attempt slot. Fix implemented: canonicalize the validated model as knowledge/evaluate-failure-protocol.md (governing contract facts; free two-call classification; path-change triage with a bounded sweep budget that separates genuine new-path defects like t1a1's shapes 31/73 from environmental per-draw dropouts like t2a2's C1 and t1a3's shape 72; the weakly-dominant fresh-bytes gamble calculus; plan-time evaluate-budgeting at P(clean)≈1/3; deposit discipline requiring in-file supersession edits), point the injected episode prompt at it at both the plan-draft and FAIL decision points, fuse trajectory-1's measured hi/lo-P numeric-margin insurance into the protocol's NUMERIC-FAIL branch and the fa2 knowledge file, and remove every surviving contradiction from knowledge/ and memory/ (stale README CAVEAT, attempt-2 headline and decision-rule text).

items.hypothesis: Bottleneck: cross-branch State fragmentation plus a mis-modeled landing economy in the winner-lineage Agent. Auditing all six epoch-2 sessions (both branches; complete conversation.jsonl action/result chains plus attempt reports) establishes two coupled facts. (a) Sibling branches are structurally blind to each other within an epoch: agent-v1's attempt 2 spent ~1/3 of its budget re-falsifying the BM=128 dead end that agent-v0's attempt 1 had falsified and deposited 36 minutes earlier, and the mirror-image cost was decisive — agent-v0 ended the epoch holding the era's only validated mechanism (a parallel split-reduction fa_combine: 1.07-1.30x on decode-floor cells, <=1 bf16 ulp, hardened with 5,765 fresh draws + memcheck/initcheck/racecheck, trusted evaluate PASS 90/90 at 249.199us) yet lost with best_kernel=null when the post-session controller seal re-draw crashed its candidate side (shapes 15/33/69, attempt counted INCORRECT), and the winning branch never saw that mechanism even though its own shipped selector regressed exactly the floor band the mechanism fixes (-0.258 log-units at <35us, -0.080 at 35-60us) and its deposited Law-3 wording ('the ~3us combine floor is not reducible') mis-scopes the combine axis as closed. (b) The winner-lineage State mis-models the landing economy: its protocol declares seal risk 'SYMMETRIC' and budgets P(clean)=1/3 from epoch 1, but epoch-2 data (~720 observed shape-draws, 5 crashes) show the seal re-draws nominations ONLY (p=0.7%/draw, P(clean evaluate)=1/2, P(land a nomination)=1/5-1/4, seal crashes correlated within one job), a branch that pivots every attempt ends at best_kernel=null and loses to any landed nomination, its re-roll reserve rule deferred the sibling's positive-EV final roll to a nonexistent attempt 4, and no protection existed against the pre-job source-validator token trap ('environ' inside 'environmental') that killed one roll digest. Causal hypothesis: fusing the sibling's validated lever with its composition path onto the winner's wave-quantised selector (a port-don't-re-land playbook: offline reachable-mass recomputation, CLAT(S) repricing against the floor-band regression, device port from the deposited spec, rewired S-aware probes), together with corrected two-stage roll economics (asymmetric seal exposure, P(land)-based budgeting, epoch-positioned reserves, an ABBA dry-run rule for sub-noise deltas) and hardened roll protections (preflight forbidden-token scan), converts more of epoch 3's fixed budget into landed correct kernels: attempt 1 composes and nominates against pre-registered bars instead of re-searching a falsely-closed frontier, and later attempts keep zero-burn discipline on the surviving agenda.

items.hypothesis: Bottleneck: the Agent's post-landing nomination decision rule — what it banks as nominated candidates after a best kernel has already landed. Epoch-4 evidence (complete audit of both branches: all sealed attempt reports and all six conversations): the challenger (agent-v3) landed v8.4 at 233.167µs sealed (ABBA 1.0254× vs the epoch input bar — clearing its own deposited ≥2% nomination bar), then forfeited the epoch by the 0.90% absolute sealed-best gap against the active branch's Plan-B 231.07µs. One causal mechanism, three coupled parts. (1) Wrong reference point: after its landing, the challenger priced every option against its own landed v8.4 instead of the epoch input bar. Its measured w3∘port composition (+1.7% vs v8.4) equals ≈1.017×1.0254 ≈ +4.3% vs the input bar (≈229.4µs) — decisive under its own deposited rule — yet was treated as sub-bar because +1.7% read against v8.4 is below a ≥2% FIRST-nomination bar that was never a post-landing criterion. (2) Axis-vs-asset conflation: attempt 3's closure map retired the w3 pipeline AXIS and concluded 'no ≥+0.7% partner exists', while attempt 2's own deposit held the w3 fa_main_w2 device-body ASSET at +0.7–0.8% aggregate, bit-identity 20/20, fully spec'd — retiring the axis was applied as retiring its measured assets. (3) Ignored post-landing asymmetric economics: a failed seal re-draw cannot un-seal the retained best, promotion follows retention not the branch verdict, and the attempt-3 reserve re-roll budget 'died unused' — zero evaluates spent in attempts 2–3 and a staged 9-hunk port map never applied. The parent bundle (candidate base) carries the mirror defects: it won epoch 4 but lost attempt 2 to the session-death class (turn ended with an ABBA compare in flight — 84.3 min/186 turns forfeited, attempt 3 consumed by recovery), a class the challenger's stop_guard Stop hook + lifecycle prompt section held to 3/3 clean terminals; and the parent never received the challenger's epoch-4 knowledge deposits (w3 spec, census closure map, v8.4 landing record). Hypothesis: encoding the post-landing decision economics explicitly — margins always referenced to the EPOCH INPUT BAR; bank every ABBA-confirmed positive delta on the landed best, bitwise-identical mechanisms unconditionally (bitwise-identity is the only seal-safe class, §8b); retiring an axis never retires its assets; last-attempt reserve inverts to SPEND when a confirmed-positive bank exists — plus a priced epoch-5 opening move, will make the epoch-5 Agent bank w3-on-Plan-B (bitwise class, expected ≈229.3–229.5µs sealed) in attempt 1 and compound confirmed deltas, instead of repeating the reference-point forfeit that decided epoch 4.
